lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like lattice of high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the branchial slits on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of blobs to form a structured matrix of pigmentation nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small teleost fish located in the ventral water column beneath the pectoral fin and branchial region.
